pages.text: River water was not for drinking. Every morning, a boat brought clean water.
Their water bucket was nearly empty. Bung set Ddori's empty cup at the bow. "Today I will fetch water and fill it."
The water boat rang a bell far away. Bung was floating a leaf boat. "Later."
Water poured onto the next boat. Ddori watched Bung, holding the empty cup.
Bung waved a hand. "I will get some next time."
The boat rang its bell and moved away. It came only once a day.
Bung tilted the bucket. Just one drop! Ddori's cup was empty.
Silently, Mom tilted her own bucket. A little water covered only the cup's bottom.
The water boat was still serving the next waterway. Bung boarded Grandpa's boat and paddled hard to catch up.
Water brimmed in Ddori's cup. Gulp, gulp! Ddori drank it all.
